packageRules.description: kafka-clients is an api dependency of nx-gs-kafka and runs on the Java 8 game server hosts; 4.x is Java 11 bytecode
Test source sets compile with release 8 like main, so Gradle resolves them for JVM 8; JUnit 6 is published for Java 17+ only
Test source sets compile with release 8 like main; WireMock 3 (wiremock-jre8 3.x relocates to org.wiremock:wiremock) is Java 11 bytecode
The suggested replacement of wiremock-jre8 is org.wiremock:wiremock 3.x, Java 11 bytecode
